parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and support for other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the base and door, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of MDF, providing a stable foundation.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and ensures the cabinet stands evenly on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel made of solid wood, attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.
